name: Lizard

modes.label: Sandbox (Small / Medium / Large, flat per second while it runs)
modes.note: Limits page Sizes table (checked 2026-11-08): Small 2 vCPU / 4 GB, 5 GB disk, $0.0162 per hour; Medium (default outside the trial) 4 vCPU / 8 GB, 20 GB disk, $0.0324 per hour; Large 8 vCPU / 16 GB, 50 GB disk, $0.0648 per hour (https://lizard.build/docs/platform/limits.md, https://lizard.build/pricing). Billed per second while the sandbox runs; a paused sandbox costs $0 in compute (https://lizard.build/pricing). The size is chosen at create time (https://lizard.build/docs/sandboxes/sdk-reference.md). During the trial, Small is the only size and sandboxes run only in US regions. A stop deletes the disk; a pause or a snapshot keeps the whole disk (https://lizard.build/docs/sandboxes.md).

plans.name: Pro trial
plans.note: "Pro starts with a 7-day trial that includes $5 of usage." (https://lizard.build/docs/platform/billing.md). Trial limits: 8 vCPU running at once (up to 4 Small sandboxes), 6 starts per minute, 30 per hour, 100 per day; Small is the only size and sandboxes run only in US regions (https://lizard.build/docs/platform/limits.md). Converts to Pro at $19 unless cancelled.

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: "Lizard has three self-serve plans: Pro at $19 a month, Pro 5x at $99 and Pro 20x at $499." "Each plan includes usage equal to its price each month." "Unused usage does not carry over to the next month." "There is no spending cap." Usage is shared with apps, databases, storage and egress across the platform (https://lizard.build/docs/platform/billing.md). Pro: 40 vCPU running at once, no limit on sandbox starts (https://lizard.build/docs/platform/limits.md, https://lizard.build/pricing). Sandbox egress: 2 TB per account included over a rolling 30 days.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: "Enterprise accounts pay as you go and get an invoice each month for the month before. Rates, limits and payment terms follow your contract." (https://lizard.build/docs/platform/billing.md). Pricing page: custom limits, signed DPA and security review, SSO / SAML, RBAC and audit log, dedicated nodes on demand; SOC 2 report "coming soon"; no HIPAA listed (https://lizard.build/pricing).

extras.price: $0.14 per GB-month (https://lizard.build/pricing); 1-50 GB per new volume and 200 GB per workspace (https://lizard.build/docs/sandboxes/volumes), while the pricing page says Pro allows "Persistent Volumes up to 100 GB each" (2026-11-08); mounts at /workspace, one sandbox at a time, node-local storage

isolation.quote: Sandboxes run as Firecracker microVMs, each with its own kernel.

ssh.quote: `lizard sandbox ssh` opens an interactive shell with your CLI credentials. SSH protocol access is not available, so SSH clients, `scp`, and port forwarding do not work.

pause_resume.quote: A pause keeps the whole disk, including packages installed outside `/workspace`, plus memory and running processes.
pause_resume.note: A pause with `fast: true` keeps the disk only; processes end and the resume boots fresh. A paused sandbox costs $0 in compute (pricing page).

snapshot_on_demand.quote: Save memory, processes and every file as a snapshot.
snapshot_on_demand.note: `Sandbox.restore` starts a new sandbox from a snapshot in its region. Attached Persistent Volumes are not captured. Snapshot storage price not published.

fork.quote: Copy a running sandbox 1 to 100 times, memory and processes included; each copy counts toward your running-sandbox limit.
fork.note: Fork returns 409 when a volume is attached (https://lizard.build/docs/sandboxes.md). Each copy bills like its source.

custom_image.quote: The public CLI does not provide a custom-template upload flow.
custom_image.note: A snapshot is saved "as a private template in its project" (quickstart), so new sandboxes can start from a prepared one.

persistent_disk.quote: you can restore it after the source sandbox is gone
persistent_disk.how: take a snapshot (or pause) before the stop and restore it on the next start; or keep files on a /workspace Persistent Volume
persistent_disk.note: "A stop (kill or expiration) deletes the sandbox's disk." A Persistent Volume (1-50 GB, node-local, one sandbox at a time) keeps /workspace only.

desktop.quote: Start the graphical desktop of a sandbox created with `-t desktop` and print its browser URL and a view-only URL.
desktop.note: `--resolution` from 640x480 to 3840x2160; `lizard sandbox vnc` connects a VNC app through a local tunnel.

harness_api.quote: `lizard sandbox prompt <id> <prompt...>` sends a prompt and streams what the agent does.
harness_api.note: Conversations (`-c`, `--new`, `lizard sandbox conversations`) and `lizard sandbox interrupt` for codex, claude, pi, opencode and prime. CLI only: the SDK reference lists no prompt method.

inbound_https.quote: `sandbox.exposePort(port)` | `sandbox.expose_port(port)` | Publish a port; return `url`, `hostname`, and the access token.
inbound_https.note: Every request needs the access token.

eu_data_residency.quote: Regional deployment Launch in US East or EU West. Choose where your agent runs.
eu_data_residency.note: Trial sandboxes run only in US regions (https://lizard.build/docs/platform/limits.md).

persist_scope.quote: you can restore it after the source sandbox is gone
persist_scope.how: call sandbox.snapshot() before the stop and Sandbox.restore() on the next start (whole disk and memory); a pause also keeps the whole disk
persist_scope.note: The sandboxes page says a snapshot "holds the whole disk". Without a snapshot or a pause, only a /workspace volume survives a stop. Nothing is saved automatically.

fork_running.quote: Copy a running sandbox 1 to 100 times, memory and processes included; each copy counts toward your running-sandbox limit.
fork_running.note: Not available with a volume attached (409).

memory_snapshot_fork.quote: Copy a running sandbox 1 to 100 times, memory and processes included; each copy counts toward your running-sandbox limit.

desktop_control.quote: The `desktop` template runs a graphical desktop that an agent controls with screenshots, clicks and keys.

computer_use.quote: The `desktop` template runs a graphical desktop that an agent controls with screenshots, clicks and keys.

browser.quote: The desktop template is a Linux desktop with Chromium.
browser.note: Page heading: "Built-in desktop and Chromium browser". docs/sandboxes.md also lists `desktop-camoufox` (US East only): "the `desktop` template plus Camoufox, a Firefox build for scraping that you drive with Playwright". No CDP/browser-control API documented.

root.quote: `process.exec` accepts `envs`, `workdir`, and `user`; commands run as `root` unless you pass `user`.

secret_proxy.quote: Lizard passes API keys and the stored Claude subscription token unchanged in each run's environment.
secret_proxy.note: Only a ChatGPT login is swapped for a short-lived access token per run; keys reach the sandbox itself.

volume_attach.quote: Each volume attaches to one sandbox at a time and uses node-local storage; export files that must survive node loss.

caveats: Isolation: each sandbox is a Firecracker microVM with its own kernel.
`lizard sandbox ssh` is a CLI shell, not the SSH protocol: SSH clients, scp and port forwarding do not work.
Default lifetime is five minutes from the SDK and CLI and no expiration from the raw API and dashboard; it is a deadline from creation, not an idle timer.
A stop deletes the disk. To keep it, take a snapshot (whole disk and memory, restorable after the sandbox is gone) or pause; a Persistent Volume keeps /workspace only. Nothing is saved automatically.
Fork makes 1 to 100 copies with memory and processes; it returns 409 with a volume attached. Snapshots do not capture an attached volume.
Sandbox egress is included up to 2 TB per account over a rolling 30 days.
Plan usage credit ($19, $99 or $499) is shared across the whole platform (apps, databases, storage, egress), not reserved for sandboxes. Overage has no spending cap.
Concurrency counts vCPU: trial 8, Pro 40, Pro 5x 220, Pro 20x 1,200. Paid plans have no limit on sandbox starts; the trial allows 6/min, 30/hour, 100/day.
Trial: Small size only, US regions only.
Persistent Volumes are node-local and attach to one sandbox at a time; Lizard says to export files that must survive node loss.
Enterprise lists a SOC 2 report as "coming soon"; no HIPAA.
Lizard also sells GitHub Actions runners (2, 4 or 8 vCPU), app hosting, managed Postgres, Redis and object storage.
Public usage counter (lizard.build/api/public/stats, 2026-10-01): 436 workspaces, 8,870 sandbox starts in total.
locations_quote: Location us-east-1 eu-west-lim-a. Regional deployment Launch in US East or EU West. Choose where your agent runs.

fleet.verification: A card is required to start the 7-day trial (8 vCPU at once); paid plan limits apply from the first paid invoice.
fleet.tiers: Pro trial 8 vCPU at once; Pro 40; Pro 5x 220; Pro 20x 1,200 (all self-serve); more through Enterprise.
fleet.notes: The plan tiers are priced as plans (max_total_vcpu), so the fleet default is the largest self-serve tier. Start caps apply to the trial only (6/min, 30/hour, 100/day). Paused sandboxes do not count.
